name: Easy Internet Services
summary: Queensland ISP. Registered 1997 as Easynet Pty Ltd with two APNIC-era allocations (EASYNET-AU 203.20.92.0-93.255, EASYNETLIMITED-AU 203.35.14.0/24; Southport/Gold Coast). By 1998 easynet.net.au was branded 'Easy Internet Services Pty. Ltd. - Mackay's Fastest growing ISP' (56k/FLEX/v.90). The company (ACN 082 852 104, ABN 68 082 852 104, Mackay QLD 4740) remains on the ABR as active; Managing Director Deon Attard since Oct 1998. Distinct from the global Easynet (UK/pan-European ISP).

events.details: Existing by 1997: EASYNET-AU 203.20.92.0-203.20.93.255 and EASYNETLIMITED-AU 203.35.14.0/24, registered to Easynet Pty Ltd, Southport QLD (Gold Coast), per the 1997 IP Network Index.
